capabilities: Shows structure previews on hover over \ch-marked chemical names
Resolves English, Brazilian Portuguese, and German names via PubChem and Wikidata
Displays compound details such as formula, molecular weight, synonyms, and PubChem CID
Renders structures locally with RDKit when Wikipedia images are unavailable
Caches resolved compounds for offline rendering and refreshes them from PubChem
extras: Manual install from the 0.1.6 release assets; first lookup needs internet, but cached compounds render offline with RDKit; failed lookups are cached 24 hours.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see a chemical's structure or properties from a name written in a note.

relations.evidence: ChemHover uses PubChem to resolve chemical names and spelling suggestions
ChemHover checks Wikidata for a matching compound
It prefers structure images from Wikipedia
ChemHover renders the structure locally with RDKit

summary: Hover-preview plugin that shows chemical structures and compound properties for \ch-marked names, preferring Wikipedia images with an RDKit fallback.
